I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Thornbury Cloth Co. 2027 renewal is 166 seats.

That number comes from the brain. On Oct 14 Ilse posted 163 in #north-team. Later that day she corrected it to 166 in #north-random, saying Thornbury's ops lead had corrected her. Dana is a member of both channels, so she could see both messages herself. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel is fine.

One gap: I couldn't find Ilse's Oct 14 messages when I read the channels directly. They only show up in the brain's saved record of them. I also found no Thornbury files on the share, so I couldn't check the figure against a contract.
